accent.displayName: Paper White (the accent is the text colour)

display-compact.purpose: The same headline below 900px. The one step the ramp takes on phones.

headline.purpose: Empty-state paragraph and the single big call to action.

brand.purpose: The wordmark in the 46px command bar. One step above body; deliberately not a display size.

body.purpose: Root size. Every control label, menu row and field value.

control.purpose: Small buttons, segmented items, chips, the sample badge.

panel-head.purpose: Small caps panel title in --faint. Hierarchy from tracking, not size.

group-head.purpose: Small caps group heading in --dim, the one place --dim carries a glyph.

tab.purpose: Inspector rail labels and tile captions. Every rail icon carries its word.

numeral.purpose: Every user-facing number: dimensions, timecodes, slider outputs, keycaps.

shadows.name: lift-1
shadows.purpose: The default. Docked chrome, groups, wells: depth is a hairline, not a shadow.

shadows.name: lift-2
shadows.purpose: Contact shadow for something resting just above its neighbour: sample badge, hovered preset, drop pill.

shadows.name: lift-3
shadows.purpose: The deepest shadow in the system. Menu popover, toast, stage plate.

shadows.name: knob
shadows.purpose: Round grab targets over the image: the timeline thumb (0.5) and crop handles (0.6). The only shadow allowed on a control.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: A preset thumbnail lifting 2px under the cursor, paired with lift-2.

shadows.name: plate-ring
shadows.purpose: The stage plate: a hairline ring so the image has an edge against any background.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: Chosen swatch, wallpaper, pattern or ink. A cut, not a halo: the inner stop is the slab colour.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Hover, colour and border state changes.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Stage and dock inset changes when the background panel opens or collapses.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Press-release on tools and buttons: damped, decelerating, never bouncing.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Things that genuinely appear: menu, toast, tool-option tray, empty card.

motion.name: tab-in
motion.purpose: Inspector body on tab change. The only entrance left in the panels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committing action in a region: Export, Open image.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: #f0f0f1; color: #131314; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0f0f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); transition-duration: 60ms; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary and reveal actions, including the picker's "Show all".
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #a0a0a4; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #f0f0f1; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0f0f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool (dock)
components.description: A 40px tool in the floating dock capsule; active takes the full accent.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 24px; background: #1a1a1c; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-dock .ds-sep { width: 1px; height: 22px; margin: 0 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-tool { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 15px; background: none; color: #a0a0a4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tool:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #f0f0f1; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0f0f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool:active { transform: scale(0.93); transition-duration: 60ms; } .ds-tool.ds-on { background: #f0f0f1; color: #131314; }

components.name: Field-slider
components.description: The signature control: the bar is the slider. Label left, tabular mono value right, dragged horizontally.
components.css: .ds-fs { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; cursor: ew-resize; user-select: none; color: #f0f0f1; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-fs:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-fs-fill { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); transition: filter 140ms; } .ds-fs:hover .ds-fs-fill { filter: brightness(1.25); } .ds-fs-fill::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: -1px; width: 3px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-fs-label { position: relative; font-weight: 450; } .ds-fs output { position: relative; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #a0a0a4; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Recessed field: a darker pane of the same slab, accent border on focus, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 34px; width: 220px; padding: 0 11px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 7px; color: #f0f0f1; caret-color: #f0f0f1; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #f0f0f1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A well holding 26px items; the selected item lifts 7% with a 1px inner top highlight.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 7px; } .ds-seg button { flex: 1; height: 26px; padding: 0 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #a0a0a4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #f0f0f1; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0f0f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg button.ds-on { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: #f0f0f1; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Optional filters and presets. Selected lights the edge and the text, not a fill colour.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #a0a0a4; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms, border-color 140ms, background 140ms; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #f0f0f1; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0f0f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip.ds-on { color: #f0f0f1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

components.name: Inspector Tab Rail
components.description: 78px recessed column of icon-over-label tabs. No tab ships icon-only.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 78px; padding: 14px 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-rail button { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 9px 2px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: none; color: #8a8a8e; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-rail button:hover { color: #f0f0f1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-rail button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0f0f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail button.ds-on { color: #f0f0f1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

components.name: Command Bar
components.description: Full-width docked bar, 46px, square corners, one bottom hairline. The brand is 14px/500 with a 5px mark.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; height: 46px; padding: 0 10px 0 14px; background: #1a1a1c; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-width: 0 0 1px; border-radius: 0; color: #f0f0f1; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-brand i { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 5px; background: #f0f0f1; } .ds-bar-sep { width: 1px; height: 22px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-dims { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #a0a0a4; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Background Tile (curated picker)
components.description: A 16:10 tile with its name over a scrim, a Moves badge when animated, and a ring when chosen.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 9px; width: 268px; } .ds-tile { position: relative; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-tile .ds-art { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: block; } .ds-a1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2b2440, #6d5aa0 60%, #caa9d9); } .ds-a2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e9e5df, #b9b2a8); } .ds-tile .ds-name { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 16px 9px 6px; text-align: left; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); } .ds-tile .ds-moves { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 99px; font-family: 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: rgba(8,6,16,0.72); color: #fff; } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0f0f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile.ds-on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1a1a1c, 0 0 0 4px #f0f0f1; }

narrative.overview:
Shotframe is a workbench, not a showroom. The interface is one unlit neutral room (--room #131314) with its chrome docked hard to the window edges, cut apart by 1px hairlines. Nothing in the chrome carries hue, nothing blurs, nothing glows, and nothing floats over anything else except the tool dock. The single saturated object on screen is the user's screenshot on the stage plate. Everything else is graphite, so the work reads true.

Density is instrument-panel tight: 34px controls, 10-16px rhythm, 10-11px uppercase small caps for every panel and group heading, and tabular mono for every numeral a user reads. The world earns its seriousness from restraint — hairline separation instead of glass, opaque fills instead of backdrop-filter, near-flat shadows instead of lift. This replaced an earlier indigo-and-gradient world that read as generated rather than built; the rejection of specular glass pills, chromatic accents and ambient runtime glow is a confirmed, durable one.

Motion is a response, never an entrance. No surface animates in on load. Press-release on tools and buttons, a 300ms tab-in when the inspector changes tab, a 180ms pop for things that genuinely appear (menus, toasts, tool options), and full honour of prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral room, zero chroma in the chrome.
The accent is the text colour (#f0f0f1); selection reads as light, not as colour.
Separation is always a 1px hairline, never blur and never glow.
Chrome docks to window edges with square corners; only the tool dock floats.
Near-flat elevation: the deepest shadow in the system is 0 2px 8px.
Small-caps labelling, tabular numerals, no icon-only tab.

rules.name: The One Lit Object Rule
rules.body: The screenshot plate is the only saturated, only genuinely lit thing on screen. If a new chrome surface needs colour to be understood, the surface is wrong, not the palette.

rules.name: The Colourless Chrome Rule
rules.body: No hue enters the interface. Every chrome value is graphite or white-alpha. State is expressed by lightness (4% → 7% → full white), never by hue.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-Light Rule
rules.body: "Selected", "focused", "on" and "primary" all read as the text colour at full strength on a room-ink ground. There is no second accent to reach for, and a gradient accent is not available.

rules.name: The Dim-Is-Not-Body Rule
rules.body: --dim never sets body text. Readable text bottoms out at --faint; --dim is reserved for the group-heading small caps and non-text marks.

rules.name: The Black-Is-For-Image Rule
rules.body: Black scrims exist only where chrome sits on top of the user's picture. Inside the panels, separation is a hairline and contrast is white-alpha; a panel never darkens itself with black.

rules.name: The Small-Caps Head Rule
rules.body: Headings inside chrome are not larger, they are smaller and spaced: 11px/0.07em uppercase in --faint for a panel, 10px/0.08em uppercase in --dim for a group. Hierarchy comes from tracking and colour, not from size.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every numeral a user reads is Spline Sans Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so a value never jitters as it changes.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Archivo for language, Spline Sans Mono for number. There is no third face, and no system-UI display face; the one system stack that remains is inside the canvas text tool, where it matches what the exported image will render.

rules.name: The Labelled Tab Rule
rules.body: No tab and no rail item ships icon-only. The inspector rail is 78px wide precisely so every icon carries its word underneath (10.5px), and it becomes a scrolling row of icon+word pairs below 900px.

rules.name: The Docked Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome meets the window edge. A panel that touches an edge has square corners on that side and a single hairline on its inner side; it does not inset itself, round itself away from the frame, or cast a shadow onto the room. Only the tool dock floats.

rules.name: The Hairline Separation Rule
rules.body: Regions are separated by exactly one 1px hairline. Never two adjacent borders, never a blur, never a gradient scrim standing in for an edge.

rules.name: The Real Height Rule
rules.body: The phone layout anchors to --plate-h, the canvas's measured height, not to a guessed offset, so nothing stacks below a dead band.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A new surface gets --lift-1 (none) unless it overlays content the user was already looking at. Shadow is permission to cover, not decoration.

rules.name: The No Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: No backdrop-filter on chrome, no ambient glow layer, no room tint sampled from the user's image. The room is a fixed neutral; the image lights nothing but itself.

rules.name: The Two Radius Families Rule
rules.body: The ladder breaks at 10. If it touches the window frame, it is square there and ≤10px inside. If it floats over the stage, it is ≥11px, and anything holding a row of controls is a capsule (24-26px). Nothing borrows the other family’s corner.

rules.name: The Point-Of-View Rule
rules.body: A picker opens on a point of view, not an inventory. The default view is a curated subset chosen by the house; the full list is always exactly one click away and never the first thing shown.

rules.name: The Micro-Rung Rule
rules.body: 2/3/4px belong to marks and canvas furniture — track, dot, handle, progress bar, focus ring. A surface never takes a micro rung; the smallest surface corner in the system is 5px.

dos: Do dock new chrome to a window edge: square corners on the edge side, one 1px --edge hairline on the inner side, no shadow.
Do express state with lightness — 4% (glass-2) hover, 7% (glass-3) selected, full accent for active.
Do use the accent (#f0f0f1 on #131314 ink) for exactly one thing at a time in a region: the on tool, the focused field, the chosen tile.
Do head panels at 11px/0.07em uppercase --faint and groups at 10px/0.08em uppercase --dim.
Do set every user-facing number in Spline Sans Mono with tabular-nums.
Do recess anything editable into a --well and raise nothing.
Do ship every rail item and tab with a visible word beside its icon.
Do open any long list on a curated subset with "Show all N" behind a quiet button.
Do reach for a black scrim only where chrome sits over the user's image (30% for a field, 60% for a caption, 75% for a readout), and keep it pure neutral black.
Do keep 2/3/4px corners for marks and canvas furniture and 5px as the smallest surface corner.
Do keep --lift-1 (none) as the default elevation and justify anything heavier by the surface actually covering content.
donts: Don't introduce a hue into the chrome — no coloured accent, no gradient accent, no tinted surface. Saturation belongs inside the plate.
Don't use backdrop-filter on chrome, an ambient glow layer, or any room tint sampled from the user's image.
Don't float a panel over the room with an inset and a drop shadow; the tool dock is the only floating surface.
Don't animate a surface in on page load.
Don't exceed 0 2px 8px of shadow, or use a shadow to imply a border.
Don't add a third typeface, or set an interface heading larger than 14px.
Don't darken a panel with black; panels separate by hairline and contrast by white-alpha.
Don't give a floating surface a docked corner, or a docked surface a capsule.
Don't double a separator: one hairline between two regions, never a border on both.
